description: Multi-model management platform for dynamic loading, management, and serving of multiple LLMs through a unified, OpenAI-compatible interface. Built on vLLM and kvcached for efficient multi-model hosting on a single GPU or across a multi-pod Kubernetes cluster.
rules: sardeenz serves an OpenAI-compatible API via vLLM; prefer the /v1/* endpoints for inference examples.
Admin auth (dashboard/controller API) uses AUTH_MODE (none | simple | oauth); inference auth is a separate optional INFERENCE_API_KEY for /v1/* endpoints.
Deployment is via the Helm chart at deploy/helm/sardeenz/ — Kustomize manifests have been removed.
Use the inference-sim backend for GPU-free local development.
